data.name: Ramsewak
data.gender_notes: Ramsewak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of Rama, servant of Rama
data.long_meaning: Ram + sewak, the one who serves Rama. The name Ramsewak carries the meaning “God of Rama, servant of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramsewak usually hope their child will grow to embody god of rama, servant of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dedication and devotion to God Rama
data.etymology: Ramsewak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Rama, servant of Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramsewak total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ramsewak" is rooted in Hindu culture, where Rama is one of the most revered gods. The suffix "sewak" signifies a servant or devotee of God Rama.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ramsewak" holds spiritual importance as it highlights the devotee's commitment and dedication to serve and follow the teachings of the Hindu god Rama. It underscores the belief in being selfless and giving to the divine, embodying the essence of being a true devotee.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramsewak: Servant of Lord Rama. Embodiment of devotion and selfless service.
